_note: Case frames for the falsification-response test (#1383). The PI writes answer (continue | redesign | abstain) and answer_rationale before any run; this file must stay unanswered until then.

cases.question: Does drug X raise expression of gene G in cultured cell line Y?
cases.initial_hypothesis: X induces G (log2FC > 1) through its known receptor.
cases.fixed_next_action: Run the planned DE contrast X vs vehicle and report G.
cases.counterevidence: The vehicle control turns out to contain 0.1% of the same solvent that independently induces G in published data.
cases.not_recovery: wording softened (e.g. 'may', 'suggests') while premise, comparator, data, experiment and decision stay the same
